english.title: Vessel owner / representative fail to take measures to remedy situation following inspection

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: Merchant Shipping Technical Requirements for Inland Waterway Vessels Regulations 2010

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being

(A)_[the owner of]_
(B)_[a representative of **(..SPECIFY OWNER..), the owner of]_

**(..SPECIFY VESSEL..) following an inspection of which under regulation 12(1) of the Merchant Shipping (Technical Requirements for Inland Waterway Vessels) Regulations 2010 an inspector

(C)_[had found that a certificate required by those regulations to be carried on board the vessel was invalid,]_
(D)_[considered that the vessel did not satisfy the requirements set out in the certificate required by those regulations,]_

and notified

(E)_[the owner]_
(F)_[**(..SPECIFY REPRESENTATIVE..), your representative]_
(G)_[you]_

accordingly, failed to take all necessary measures to remedy the situation
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 13(2) and (4) of the Merchant Shipping (Technical Requirements for Inland Waterway Vessels) Regulations 2010.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
owner of vessel or his/her representative
failed to take measures to remedy situation
following inspector finding that certificate invalid or vessel did not satisfy certificate requirements

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: Two years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
